dos.title: Use Kaspi QR or cashless payments
dos.description: Cash is rarely needed in Kazakh cities; virtually every merchant from coffee carts to boutiques accepts Kaspi QR or Visa/Mastercard.

dos.title: Remove shoes when entering a Kazakh home
dos.description: Always take off outdoor shoes at the threshold and put on slippers provided by the host.

dos.title: Receive tea and food with both hands or right hand
dos.description: Showing deference to elders and hosts by accepting tea bowls (piala) with respect is deeply appreciated.

donts.title: Don't jaywalk in city centers
donts.description: Traffic police actively fine pedestrians for crossing streets outside designated zebra crossings in Astana and Almaty.

donts.title: Don't overstay the 30-day visa-free limit
donts.description: Immigration laws enforce strict fines and deportation proceedings for exceeding 30-day entry allowances.

etiquette.tipping: A service charge of 10% is usually included on restaurant bills in Almaty and Astana; leaving extra small change is appreciated.
